title: Warren Towers existing Commonwealth Avenue sidewalk and central entrance approach
scope: North frontage only; continuous existing-condition hardscape replaces a procedural grass gap. Building envelope, facade, doors, road widths, global DEM, travel routes and existing colliders are unchanged.

evidence: Figure 1-3 existing-condition photographs show light gray continuous hardscape reaching the four central doors and storefronts, with individual street-tree pits rather than a continuous grass strip against the building.
Public Realm describes an existing 20 ft sidewalk, approximately 10 ft sheltered by the vaulted canopy.

Section 3.6.1 describes the existing approximately 8 ft furnishing zone, 16 inch permeable paver edge, street trees in pits (some with grates), raised granite planters with plant guards, and other street furnishings.

sources.evidence: Renovation FAQ describes future sidewalk regrading, new planters, and new canopies/storefront work; this pass does not claim that proposed renovation geometry is completed.

surveyBacked.buildingFootprint: BU_FULL_BUILDINGS warren-towers, City source vertices preserved
surveyBacked.street: BU_ROAD_EDGES Commonwealth south carriageway, existing 10.2 m model width; perpendicular intersections with the actual piecewise road segments, not an endpoint projection
surveyBacked.elevation: buElevation shared DEM and existing Warren rigid threshold base; no change to source terrain

authoredOrEstimated.entry: Same 55.1% from west anchor and 12.5 m opening as current photograph-calibrated facade; not an independently surveyed door center.
authoredOrEstimated.pavers: 0.4064 m strip width follows the EPNF existing 16 inch description; individual brick module, color, and exact current paving subdivision are estimates.
authoredOrEstimated.surface: Concrete 0.118 m above existing terrain avoids overlap with old +0.102/+0.105 m infill; this is the existing game's road surface convention, not a new physical survey height.
authoredOrEstimated.entryTransition: Last 2.4 m blends locally to the current facade's base+0.20 m stone threshold, with a 1 m lateral blend. It is a playable join, not a surveyed accessibility reconstruction.
authoredOrEstimated.trees: Four accepted existing procedural tree positions and square pits are retained without relocation or duplication; this is not a verified contemporary tree inventory.
authoredOrEstimated.unresolvedScale: The retained GIS/model road-to-facade gap is about 7–8 m locally, whereas the EPNF reports a 20 ft (6.096 m) sidewalk. This pass does not move the surveyed building footprint or established road/navigation geometry to conceal that discrepancy.
authoredOrEstimated.excluded: Temporary 2026 works, future proposed planter enlargements, and unverified bench/bike-rack positions are not invented.

integration.oldTreeSelector: None needed on desktop. The mobile builder explicitly retains these four existing street trees because generic tree stride may omit them; the helper itself does not emit trees.
integration.mobileTreePits: The mobile bake discards the old street-detail group, so the helper restores only these four pit sites in two extra soil/granite batches. Soil sits at terrain+0.112 m, avoiding the retained old terrain+0.105 m sidewalk; frames extend from +0.11 to +0.15 m. Their 0.965 m exterior half-width fits the same paving cutouts. They are low ground surfaces, not new blocking walls.
integration.quality: Desktop/mobile share identical main paving buffers (2 spatially bounded material batches); mobile adds 2 bounded tree-pit batches and uses the existing no-texture material pipeline.
